name: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Ltd
title: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Ltd - 538920 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity jumped 6,500→11,000 MT (+69%) with FY27 utilisation guided at ~95%, but FDC phase 2 is pushed to FY29-30 and management flagged possible ECB-only funding for it.

utilisation.quote: Around 95% capacity utilization will be there this year out of the 11,000 metric tons

triggers.label: Capacity 6,500 → 11,000 MT
triggers.quote: increasing production capacity further from 6,500 metric tons to 11,000 annually, representing an increase of approximately 69%

triggers.label: FDC phase 2 capex INR370-400 cr
triggers.quote: it should be in the region of around INR 370 crores to INR 400 crores

triggers.label: FY27 utilisation ~95%
triggers.quote: we are expecting around 95% capacity utilization

triggers.label: Realisation up 2-3% via mix
triggers.quote: it should be in the region of around 2% to 3%

triggers.label: FDC commissioning slipped to Q2 FY28
triggers.quote: we currently expect 5,500 metric tons annual capacity facility to be completed by Q2 FY27-'28

guidance.quote: Out of this 95%, production should come to approximately 10,200 to 10,400 metric tons.
it should be in the region of around 22% to 24%.
we currently expect 5,500 metric tons annual capacity facility to be completed by Q2 FY27-'28
An additional debt component of around INR 300 crores will be added to the existing debt for FY28, along with INR 100 crores for working capital.
The debt interest rate will be approximately 8.3% to 8.4%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we currently expect 5,500 metric tons annual capacity facility to be completed by Q2 FY27-'28

red_flags.label: Investor email unanswered
red_flags.quote: like not getting any response. Is there any other mail ID

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT 12.7% margin while FDC ECB-funded debt rises
red_flags.quote: funding it through internal accruals may be difficult. We may have to go for ECB only.

red_flags.label: Customer concentration top 5-6 = 45-50%
red_flags.quote: the top five to six customers contribute approximately 45% to 50% of the business

evasions.quote: At this point in time, it is very difficult for me to comment on the second phase
